definitions.explanation: The manager in charge of a section (課) within a department in a company.

examples.japanese: {課長|かちょう}に{相談|そうだん}してください。
examples.english: Please consult with the section chief.

examples.japanese: {田中|たなか}{課長|かちょう}は{来週|らいしゅう}{出張|しゅっちょう}です。
examples.english: Section Chief Tanaka has a business trip next week.

examples.japanese: やっと{課長|かちょう}に{昇進|しょうしん}しました。
examples.english: I finally got promoted to section chief.

notes:
{課長|かちょう} is a section manager, an important first management position in Japanese companies.

CORPORATE HIERARCHY:
- {係長|かかりちょう}: team leader
- {課長|かちょう}: section chief
- {次長|じちょう}: deputy department head
- {部長|ぶちょう}: department head

USAGE AS TITLE:
Used after names: {田中|たなか}{課長|かちょう} (Section Chief Tanaka). When addressing directly, use {課長|かちょう} alone or with さん in some companies.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {課長|かちょう}に{昇進|しょうしん}する: to be promoted to section chief
- {課長|かちょう}{代理|だいり}: acting section chief
- {課長|かちょう}{補佐|ほさ}: assistant section chief

NOTE:
{課|か} (section) is a subdivision of {部|ぶ} (department).
